metaTitle: Custom Recycled PET Coasters | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom recycled PET coasters for eco-friendly branding. Perfect for tradeshows and offices. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Recycled PET coasters are made from post-consumer plastic bottles, giving discarded materials a second life as durable, heat-resistant drinkware accessories. For businesses committed to sustainability, these coasters communicate environmental responsibility at every meeting, conference, or client lunch. They accept full-color imprinting with crisp detail, making your logo or message stand out while supporting green initiatives. Choose recycled PET coasters to align your promotional products with your company's eco-conscious values.
heroAltText: Custom recycled PET coasters with full-color logo imprint, set on a table with drinks
